title: I vibe coded a sushi conveyor belt game inspired by cooking fever games
author: PerspectiveCalm9086

comments.author: _AssetSmithy_
comments.body: A cool idea with the receipt!

comments.author: Fair-History4870
comments.body: Looks great! Did you use AI for your art assets as well? If so, what was your pipeline?

replies.author: PerspectiveCalm9086
replies.body: Thank you! Yes I did use a mixture of hand drawn and AI art. The main sushi sprites were hand drawn by an artist. For the other assets I used ChatGPT’s imagegen and then put those images into https://giventofly.github.io/pixelit/ to actually pixelate them and then cleaned them up a bit my hand.

comments.author: MikesWorldNYC
comments.body: I would totally play this. Hell yeah!

replies.author: PerspectiveCalm9086
replies.body: Thank you for the kind words! 😁

comments.body: Looks good and professional. Like asked was the art Ai also?
